source_text: Mosquito collections were conducted in April and May 2018 in Tulukuyi village located in Bungoma County 0.56°N 34.56°E 1427m ASL (Fig. 1)... Sampling was performed by aspiration of blood fed and gravid mosquitoes from 39 houses... Prior to species identification, forced oviposition was used to generate isofemale F1 progeny... A total of 133 F1 virgin, non-blood fed adult females aged 2–3days were tested for permethrin resistance
